en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

en: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
u.src: 1  Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

p.src: 2  The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
u.src: 2  The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

p.src: 3  The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

en: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
u.src: 3  The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

p.src: 4  I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

en: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
u.src: 4  I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

p.src: 5  My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

en: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
u.src: 5  My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

p.src: 6  If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

en: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
u.src: 6  If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

p.src: 7  All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

en: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
u.src: 7  All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

p.src: 8  “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
u.src: 8  “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

p.src: 9  Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

en: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
u.src: 9  Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

p.src: 10  But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

en: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
u.src: 10  But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

p.src: 11  By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

en: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
u.src: 11  By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

p.src: 12  As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

en: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
u.src: 12  As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

p.src: 13  Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
u.src: 13  Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
